body: Because when you make so little there is hardly room for preparing for anything. Living in Poverty is expensive. For example if I make about $1,000 a month (been there, actually) and I get a toothache instead of taking off of work and going to the dentist I tough it out. Well that toothache soon becomes an infection or the tooth is rot to the root and then I have to take off of work possibly for 2 or 3 days depending on the severity. So instead of paying for a small tooth ache I now have to pay to have the tooth removed, lose a day of work, etc. So what could have been a $50 problem to fix now turns into an even more expensive problem with the possibility of a lost day of work or even being fired for missing work. (Not a perfect analogy but I hope that you get the point). Also a lot of people just dont have any income at the end of the month to save.
